title: The Speed-to-Lead Playbook
kicker: A practical guide for real estate agents and brokers
subtitle: How to answer every portal lead in minutes, qualify it, book the viewing and keep slow buyers warm, with you approving what matters.

overview.heading: The four automations at a glance
overview.intro: Each automation runs on its own, and they share the same lead record. Start with the instant reply: it's the one that stops leads going cold while you're out at viewings.

items.title: Connected tools

items.text: Viewings, prices and anything unusual come to you first. Every message is logged.

workflows.name: Reply instantly
workflows.goal: Every new lead gets a helpful reply in minutes, in your tone, even when you're at a viewing or it's late at night.
workflows.trigger: A new enquiry email or notification from a property portal, your website form, Instagram DM or WhatsApp Business.
steps: Read the enquiry and pull out the name, contact details, listing and question.
Create or update the lead in your CRM, tagged with its portal or channel.
Reply from your approved templates with the listing's facts and viewing days.
Ask one simple question to keep the conversation going, then notify you.
tools: Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, Zoho CRM or a Google Sheet
Email or WhatsApp Business, with ChatGPT or Claude
workflows.approval: the AI only sends replies built from templates and listing details you approved. Anything off-script comes to you.

workflows.name: Qualify the lead
workflows.goal: You know who is ready to buy or rent before you spend time on a call.
workflows.trigger: The lead replies to the first message.
steps: Ask about budget, preferred areas, timeline and how they plan to pay.
Save each answer to the lead record in your CRM.
Score the lead as hot, warm or cold using the rules you set.
Summarise the lead in three lines for you or the agent who owns it.
tools: WhatsApp Business, website chat or email
ChatGPT or Claude, with your question list
workflows.approval: you set the questions and the scoring rules. The AI never promises prices, availability or terms.

workflows.name: Route and book viewings
workflows.goal: Hot leads reach the right agent fast, and viewings get booked without phone tag.
workflows.trigger: A lead is scored hot, or asks to see a property.
steps: Pick the agent by area, listing or rota, and send them a WhatsApp alert with the summary.
Check that agent's calendar and suggest open viewing slots.
Wait for the agent to approve or change the slot.
Confirm the viewing with the buyer and send a reminder the day before.
workflows.approval: no viewing is confirmed until an agent taps approve.

workflows.name: Keep slow leads warm
workflows.goal: Buyers who aren't ready yet still think of you when they are.
workflows.trigger: A lead says they're not ready yet, or hasn't replied after the days you set.
steps: Send a friendly check-in on a rhythm you choose, for example day 2, 7 and 14.
Watch new listings and pick the ones that match the lead's budget and area.
Send the matches with a short note and an easy way to book a viewing.
Move the lead back to hot, and alert you, as soon as they reply with interest.
tools: your CRM's follow-ups, or Make, Zapier or n8n
your portal feed, website or a Google Sheet
workflows.approval: only check-ins you approved go out automatically, and leads can opt out at any time.
